description: This file defines the SeoTransform class, a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel implementation for URL SEO transformations within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for URL rewriting based on regex patterns, handling request and response objects, and configuration checks.

classes.name: SeoTransform
classes.description: Implements a Freemarker URL transformation for SEO-friendly URLs, including URL rewriting based on regex patterns and session handling.

methods.name: checkArg
methods.description: Checks a boolean argument from a map, returning a default if not present or not a boolean string.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that processes URL transformation, handling request context and URL prefixing.

methods.name: seoUrl
methods.description: Transforms a URL into an SEO-friendly version based on regex patterns and session rules.
